basis: The chart's y-axis is labeled 'Respiratory infection cases' with tick marks at 0, 700, 1400, 2100, and 2800. The x-axis represents years from 2012 to 2023. The plotted purple line begins in 2012 at a level slightly above the 700 mark. It trends generally upward, reaching a peak in 2022 significantly above the 2800 mark (estimated near 3000). The final point for 2023 is slightly lower than the 2022 peak but remains well above the 2800 mark. Comparing the start (2012, ~800) to the end (2023, ~2900) shows a substantial net increase in respiratory infection cases over the surveillance period.
